corrections.recommended_public_paragraph: CQC’s register identifies China Telecom’s Jing-Jin-Ji Big Data Industry Park Data Center at 6 Huiwangdao, Gaocun Science and Technology Innovation Park, Wuqing District, Tianjin. Entry 41 on page 14 lists certificate CQC240920355029, CQC Enhanced Level (L3), valid from November 27, 2024 to November 26, 2027. This is certification and address evidence; it does not establish an opening or a later operating observation.
corrections.implementation_scope: Apply this paragraph only to the Wuqing project. The exact PDF URL and hash produce a shared evidence record also used by Haoyang; do not globally replace its Haoyang-specific entry-46 paragraph or invent a second original PDF capture. Keep source provenance and per-project entry references distinct. Preserve Huiwangdao spelling; no alias to mapped Huiwanglu is asserted.

corrections.candidate: Mirai Ogaki Data Center Campus Existing Operations
corrections.review: Read the original September 29 interview capture and live original. Named president Ito describes use of abundant Ogaki groundwater to improve air-conditioning efficiency. In response to a GPU-hosting question he reports very few enquiries and says the facilities are not specifically designed for high power density. No numerical PUE or building-specific cooling design is supplied.
corrections.recommended_public_paragraph: In an interview published on September 29, 2026, Mirai president Yoshihito Ito said the Ogaki operation uses groundwater to improve cooling efficiency. He described very few GPU-server enquiries and said its facilities were not designed specifically for high power density. These statements concern the Ogaki operation collectively; they do not provide building-specific cooling specifications or a numeric PUE.
corrections.implementation_scope: Add as source-linked context without changing lifecycle status, observation day, building count, capacity or workload classifications. The exact interview day is unknown; September 29 is publication. Do not turn a lack of high-density specialization into a claim that all GPU hosting is impossible.
